title: My Weekend Plans
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hi, Adam. What are you doing this weekend?
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا آدم. ماذا ستفعل في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Hi, Lina. On Friday, I will visit my grandparents.
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا لينا. يوم الجمعة سأزور جدي وجدتي.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do they live near you?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No, they live in another part of the city.
dialogue.translation_ar: لا، يعيشان في جزء آخر من المدينة.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: How will you get there?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I will take the train in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That sounds fun. What about Saturday?
dialogue.translation_ar: هذا يبدو ممتعًا. وماذا عن السبت؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: On Saturday, I want to relax at home.
dialogue.translation_ar: يوم السبت أريد الاسترخاء في المنزل.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Will you watch a movie?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, and I will read my new book.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What are your weekend plans?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I will go shopping with my sister.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What do you need to buy?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I need new shoes for school.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Are you free on Saturday afternoon?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل أنت متفرغ بعد ظهر السبت؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, I have no plans then.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، ليس لدي خطط في ذلك الوقت.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Let's meet at the café at four.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Okay. I can be there at four.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: We can have tea and talk.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: See you on Saturday, Lina.

What does Lina need to buy?
